snippet.title: Zero Division | Steam PC | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Cyberpunk-themed CCG roguelite deckbuilder, “Zero Division,” will be officially released on July 12, 2024, on Steam!

Easy to pick up but hard to master, with a deep, tactical core and a wealth of encounter mechanisms inspired by classic MMOs, Zero Division features nine unique operators, each with its own deck, four distinct gameplay modes, eleven progressively unlocked difficulty tiers, six different stages filled with random events and formidable enemies, and hundreds of meticulously designed cards.

Check it out at:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2181950/Zero_Division/
